mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_billing_reservation (hyperlink_task_id, billing_provider, quote_id, quote_expires_at, price_code, pricing_mode, currency_code, unit_price, pricing_breakdown, quoted_recipient_count, quoted_amount, reservation_status, pending_operation, operation_idempotency_key, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{hyperlinkTaskId}, #{billingProvider}, #{quoteId}, #{quoteExpiresAt}, #{priceCode}, #{pricingMode}, #{currencyCode}, #{unitPrice}, #{pricingBreakdown}, #{quotedRecipientCount}, #{quotedAmount}, #{reservationStatus}, #{pendingOperation}, #{operationIdempotencyKey}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET pending_operation=3, operation_idempotency_key=#{operationKey}, next_retry_at=0, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND reservation_status IN (2,3,4) AND pending_operation=0 AND external_reservation_no IS NOT NULL

UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET reservation_status=CASE WHEN #{settledAmount} >= reserved_amount THEN 4 ELSE 3 END, pending_operation=0, settled_amount=#{settledAmount}, settled_send_count=#{settledSendCount}, settled_at=#{now}, operation_idempotency_key=NULL, next_retry_at=NULL, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND reservation_status IN (2,3,4,6) AND pending_operation=3 AND operation_idempotency_key=#{operationKey}

UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET pending_operation=4, operation_idempotency_key=#{operationKey}, next_retry_at=0, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND reservation_status IN (2,3,4) AND pending_operation=0 AND external_reservation_no IS NOT NULL

UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET reservation_status=5, pending_operation=0, released_amount=0, released_at=#{now}, operation_idempotency_key=NULL, next_retry_at=NULL, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND pending_operation=1 AND external_reservation_no IS NULL AND reserved_amount=0

UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET reservation_status=5, pending_operation=0, released_amount=0, released_at=#{now}, operation_idempotency_key=NULL, next_retry_at=NULL, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND reservation_status=6 AND pending_operation=1 AND failure_code=#{failureCode} AND external_reservation_no IS NULL AND reserved_amount=0 AND settled_amount=0 AND released_amount=0 AND settled_send_count=0 AND reserved_at IS NULL AND settled_at IS NULL AND released_at IS NULL

UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET billing_provider=#{entity.billingProvider}, quote_id=#{entity.quoteId}, quote_expires_at=#{entity.quoteExpiresAt}, price_code=#{entity.priceCode}, pricing_mode=#{entity.pricingMode}, currency_code=#{entity.currencyCode}, unit_price=#{entity.unitPrice}, pricing_breakdown=#{entity.pricingBreakdown}, quoted_recipient_count=#{entity.quotedRecipientCount}, quoted_amount=#{entity.quotedAmount}, reserved_amount=0, settled_amount=0, released_amount=0, settled_send_count=0, reservation_status=1, pending_operation=1, operation_idempotency_key=#{entity.operationIdempotencyKey}, next_retry_at=0, external_reservation_no=NULL, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, reserved_at=NULL, settled_at=NULL, released_at=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{entity.updatedAt} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{entity.hyperlinkTaskId} AND reservation_status=5 AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE hyperlink_billing_reservation SET billing_provider=#{entity.billingProvider}, quote_id=#{entity.quoteId}, quote_expires_at=#{entity.quoteExpiresAt}, price_code=#{entity.priceCode}, pricing_mode=#{entity.pricingMode}, currency_code=#{entity.currencyCode}, unit_price=#{entity.unitPrice}, pricing_breakdown=#{entity.pricingBreakdown}, quoted_recipient_count=#{entity.quotedRecipientCount}, quoted_amount=#{entity.quotedAmount}, reservation_status=1, pending_operation=1, operation_idempotency_key=#{entity.operationIdempotencyKey}, next_retry_at=0, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, reserved_at=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{entity.updatedAt} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{entity.hyperlinkTaskId} AND reservation_status=6 AND pending_operation=1 AND external_reservation_no IS NULL AND reserved_amount=0 AND settled_amount=0 AND settled_send_count=0 AND version=#{expectedVersion}
